proposals.evidence: DEDR1025 gives Kota orbād nine and Sholur onbād, with comparative Tamil onpatu and Tulu ormba. LSI vorupāde is proposed at this nine article on the corresponding or/pād sequence and exact numeral value; initial v, intervening u, p versus b and final e are explicit qualifications. Do not analyse it as an independent one+ten compound or move it to3918 merely because orbād appears there.
